description: This is an end-to-end test script using Playwright to validate the user registration flow in the ApplicantPortal's login/signup UI. It includes functions to generate unique emails, wait for specific UI outcomes, and tests to verify successful registration, password policy enforcement, and error handling.

methods.name: uniqueEmail
methods.description: Generates a unique email address for signup attempts based on current timestamp and random number.

methods.name: expectSignupTerminalOutcome
methods.description: Waits for one of the terminal outcome messages (success or specific errors) to appear on the page, indicating the result of the signup attempt.
